demo.title: batch-payouts.sh
demo.code:
# 1. Validate the batch (free) — never skip this step
curl -sS -X POST https://gateway.spraay.app/free/validate-batch \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"chain":"base","token":"USDC","recipients":[{"to":"0xAbc...123","amount":"150.00"},{"to":"0xDef...456","amount":"89.50"}]}' | jq

# Fix every entry in .errors before proceeding. If .summary.uniqueAddresses
# is less than .summary.recipientCount, the list has duplicates — flag them.

# 2. Estimate cost (free ballpark: 0.3% protocol fee + gas)
curl -sS 'https://gateway.spraay.app/free/estimate-batch?recipients=2' | jq

# 3. Execute (paid, $0.02 via x402) — N recipients, ONE transaction on Base.
#    Show recipient count, total USDC, the 0.3% fee, and estimated gas, and get
#    an explicit yes from the user first. On-chain payouts are irreversible.
#    Note the shape change: execute takes parallel arrays plus the sender.
curl -sS -X POST https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/batch/execute \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"token":"USDC","sender":"0xPayerWallet...","recipients":["0xAbc...123","0xDef...456"],"amounts":["150.00","89.50"]}' | jq

# Success returns a transactions array — link each hash as
# https://basescan.org/tx/<hash> when summarizing back to the user.

setup: No API key needed for the free tier — `POST /free/validate-batch` and `GET /free/estimate-batch` on `https://gateway.spraay.app` are open, rate-limited to 60 req/min per IP

Execution is a paid x402 endpoint ($0.02): fund a Base wallet with USDC, or connect the Spraay MCP server (https://smithery.ai/servers/Plagtech/Spraay-x402-mcp) to settle x402 payments automatically. Payment details: https://gateway.spraay.app/.well-known/x402.json
Non-custodial — funds move only when the payer's wallet signs. Batch contract on Base: `0x1646452F98E36A3c9Cfc3eDD8868221E207B5eEC` (verified on BaseScan), 0.3% protocol fee collected on-chain
